raw_agent_config.description: Raw optional agent configuration; fill defaults then validate normalized agent_config and semantic enabled-model capability gates. Existing clients may omit this entire section.

setup_project_input.description: Existing project fields and their original semantic validators remain authoritative; agent omission on retained id preserves old policy. Array submission remains full project replacement.

setup_server_input.description: Existing loopback, URL-path, port-conflict and default validations still run in config.py; no changed port default in overlay.

setup_tunnel_input.description: Preserves current schema; HTTPS/credentials/query/fragment and actual named-tunnel restrictions remain in baseline code.

setup_config_put_request.description: Preserves exact old top-level request shape. revision keeps old 64-character request check rather than silently imposing a new hex regex. Runtime ConfigStore verifies equality. Old requests may omit agent and project.agent; safe preservation merge is required.

setup_config_put_response_overlay.description: Success overlay only. Existing fields canonical/config_error/applied.action/applied.revision/projects keep their original shapes. Successful save still requires applied.verified=true.

credential_context_id.description: Opaque identity/version binding; never a credential or secret-derived public hash.

semantic_invariants: All request objects reject unknown keys; whitespace-only strings rejected in semantic validation.
project_context idempotency scope = verified owner_id + project_id + operation + request_id. Persist before starting a process.
Retries compare effective parameters against the first frozen defaults; max_chars is presentation-only and excluded from execution fingerprint.
Existing result binding is reused even after config change; expired result returns RESULT_EXPIRED and never restarts.
task_poll requires exactly one of task_id or report_id. report_id remains readable independently of CLI session availability.
Cursor binds object/version/section/start/page-budget; same cursor reproduces data and next_cursor; explicit conflicting section or max_chars rejected.
Recheck current caller/project/file authorization on every task/report/cancel/cache read. IDs and cursors are not bearer authorization.
No raw CLI session ID, global Windows identity, executable path, argv, env, credentials or unrestricted shell exposed to web MCP callers.
Model/usage/cost unknown values remain null or unknown, never invented zero; cumulative session usage not summed per task.

Schema validation alone does not prove byte/character limits. Enforce input UTF-8 <=65536 bytes, output business JSON <=min(request max_chars, configured limit,32000) Unicode codepoints and <=131072 UTF-8 bytes.
response_chars is the final compact ensure_ascii=false serialized business object character count including its own digits. returned_chars counts page.text only.
Default max_chars=12000; task status remains compact; wait_seconds default0 max20; report-mode wait must0.
Cancellation terminal states require process-tree exit confirmation; accepted cancellation cannot be overwritten by late success.
task completion/verification differ from process exit status. task error in successful poll does not make the poll an HTTP failure.
Disk revision uses TOML bytes hash; config_revision/applied.revision use normalized running config hash; do not compare them directly.
Missing CLI cannot block old 15 tools, Setup config save, MCP startup, or tunnel lifecycle.
OAuth401/403 are not network down; trusted health/config application, network reachability, protocol readiness, CLI readiness, and real ChatGPT authorization are separate.
X-Setup-Probe is not authentication and must not suppress business-task audit.
Existing public_verified retains actual MCP initialize/ping/list_projects verification semantics; protected reachable endpoint may instead report auth_required with public_verified=false.
No model request in setup_agent_probe or periodic status/probe; saved executable selection only.
Storage index/idempotency tombstones outlive expired report bodies.
Legacy Setup saves omitting new agent fields must preserve existing top-level agent and per-project agent for retained project IDs. Explicit disabled remains meaningful.
Configuration option defaults are not a claim of installed Codex version, model availability, cost ceiling, or enforced Windows sandbox.
overview returns kind=report only for a fresh cache; stale/no report triggers an explicitly requested budgeted reading task. Background freshness checks and task_poll never trigger a model request.

Enabled profiles require an explicit nonempty model. Empty model can be saved only while agent capability is disabled. Execution requires T02 installed-version and enforcement validation; no silent CLI default model fallback.
fresh_with_report reuse is mandatory in v1. native_resume is an optional internally gated verified optimization and adds no public tool input.

T03 ADR must freeze auth configuration field lineage, validation, persistence, API consumers, dedicated credential writes, reload/restart and rollback before T06 starts; provider-private fields are not permanently undefined.

GET /api/info adds ui_contract_version and ui_asset_version. Script declares compatible contract/build version. Verify old open tab + new backend and new script + old backend behavior, not just cache headers.
Taskpack sources contain original PRD and evidence manifest, not copied product source. Function anchors refer to the actual local project root.
requested_model is always the explicit nonempty frozen configured model for an accepted task; resolved_model may remain null.

Old already-open JS cannot execute newly added start() version guards. Test this explicitly; backend compatibility handling must never turn protected-endpoint401 into public_verified=true to satisfy an old UI. New-feature writes may require an explicit refresh error while safe legacy routes remain compatible.
New MCP tool annotations are listed in mcp_tools. Keep the old 15 tool annotations unchanged. Annotations are hints, not enforcement.
Successful Setup save requires both config_loaded and local_health true. ready tunnel requires actual MCP verification; auth_required requires reachable validated discovery and public_verified=false.
Enabled normalized profiles require a non-whitespace model, including when nested under Setup data.agent. verified enforcement requires nonempty mechanisms and tested_boundaries.

Capability default is OFF at global and project levels. Disabled status/probe/catalog reads launch zero Codex subprocesses and perform zero model requests. 18 tools remain stably registered; project_context returns CAPABILITY_DISABLED before scheduling.
auth_mode is unselected/chatgpt/api_key, independent from enabled. There is no disabled auth mode. Persist canonical singular agent.*, never parallel agents.* or codex_enabled fields.

A selected billing identity is never inferred from environment precedence. ChatGPT mode strips conflicting API credentials from the child; API mode uses only the selected endpoint-bound credential. No fallback between identities/providers/models.
forced_login_method may log out mismatched cached auth; never use it as a side-effect-free probe against the user shared Codex home.

Credential secrets never enter TOML, task/report storage, source control, logs, command line, stdout, project snapshots, normal project-bath backups or MCP responses. Protected secret storage is a separate localhost write-only surface.
cost_basis remains reported/estimated/unknown. Billing account source is execution_context.billing_source; api is not a valid cost_basis value.

Subscription and API profiles both expose model selection and supported reasoning/service controls. Catalog visibility is not proof of access; auth/key/provider/CLI/model/options changes invalidate verification.
No invented codex models --json command; feature-detect codex debug models (including --bundled) against the installed CLI, or retain manual model ID entry and an honestly labelled cache.

Model, reasoning effort and service tier are frozen at acceptance and explicitly passed using tested CLI wire mappings. Empty reasoning effort means disclosed model default after clearing inherited profile effort. standard must not inherit premium Fast Mode.

Explicit test action uses allow_model_request=true, request_id, saved config revision and credential revision. It shares the task manager and costs may occur. Save/status/dropdown/catalog refresh never imply a model trial.

Global OFF cancels queued tasks and requests owned-process cleanup for running tasks; no new process/model request is admitted. Previously completed reports remain readable only under current project/data access controls.

Production development target is the current live directory. Preserve active connection, canonical TOML, live assets and shared Codex config. No automatic restart, checkout/reset or cutover while @local is in use.
configuration_schema_scope: Normalized agent_config adds schema_version 2.0.0; raw legacy fields remain optional and default to disabled/unselected. Validate saved syntax separately from CLI/auth/model readiness. Credentials are not config fields.

overlay_policy.purpose: Validate required increments for new FE/BE contract while preserving the legacy API baseline. Response overlays explicitly allow additionalProperties so they do not freeze or remove existing fields.
overlay_policy.request_compatibility: PUT top-level revision/data is unchanged. Legacy body may omit all new agent fields. Normalization plus preservation merge occurs before canonical validation. Existing validators still reject legacy invalid values.
overlay_policy.response_compatibility: On the upgraded server agent fields and auth/network/UI increments are required by new overlays; old client can ignore these additions. Old server is detected by /api/info version check rather than incorrectly treated as compatible.
overlay_policy.status_shape: Existing local/public state/url/latency, history epoch timestamps, config revision fields, activity, startup, events and owner pid retain baseline structures. New timestamp fields use separate checked_at UTC strings.
overlay_policy.transport_budget: Setup _json_body 65536-byte limit remains; new MCP business output 32000-character cap is not retroactively imposed on existing Setup responses.
overlay_policy.error_shape: Setup error remains error.code/message/hint plus optional increments. Do not force MCP schema_version/recoverable/retriable/task_id onto legacy Setup errors.
